The handbook is large. These curated paths walk you through the pages that
matter most for common situations, in the right order. Each one is
short — a 30-minute read at most — and ends with a checklist.

::: {.role-grid}
::: {.role-card}
### [New Research Associate](new-ra.qmd)
Your first two weeks at IE. CITI training, accounts, IRB-on-record,
data security setup.
:::

::: {.role-card}
### [New Research Manager](new-rm.qmd)
Setting up a new project: budgets, trackers, partner agreements,
team rituals.
:::

::: {.role-card}
### [PI Prepping a Grant](pi-prepping-grant.qmd)
Proposal narrative, budgeting at IE, IRB pre-registration, AEA registry,
partner letters.
:::

::: {.role-card}
### [Visiting Researcher](visiting-researcher.qmd)
Arriving at YIE / IEIC / IEN: visa, accommodations, day-one logistics,
safety contacts.
:::
:::

::: {.who-to-ask}
If your situation isn't covered by one of these paths, ping
`#handbook` on Slack or open an
[issue on GitHub](https://github.com/hks-epod/inclusion-economics-handbook/issues/new/choose).
We add new paths when we see the same question more than twice.
:::
